label: Написав
description: A 10-sentence card for написав, the perfective gerund of написать.

missions.phrase: Написав письмо, он пошёл на почту.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: prior action, front position. Написав is the perfective gerund of написать, built from the perfective stem plus -в. It marks an action completed before the main verb: he finished the letter, then went to the post office. The gerund clause leads, set off by a comma.

missions.phrase: Написав заявление, я отдал его секретарю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: completed then handed over. Написав reports the prior finished writing (perfective stem + -в); the handing over followed. One subject does both: I wrote, I handed it in.

missions.phrase: Написав отчёт, мы отправим его директору.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: future main clause. The main verb is future (отправим), yet написав still fixes the earlier completed action. A perfective gerund orders the events: write first, send later, one shared subject.
Strategic focus: same-subject rule. The gerund and the main verb share one subject: SHE wrote the message, SHE put the phone away. Написав is indeclinable, so meaning, not an ending, ties it to она.

Strategic focus: plural subject, no agreement. The subject is plural (школьники), but написав takes no plural ending — gerunds do not agree, unlike participles. Sequence: dictation written, then notebooks handed in.

Strategic focus: gerund in end position. The gerund clause follows the main verb here, but the order stands: he wrote the last line first, then smiled. Написав keeps one fixed form wherever it appears.

Strategic focus: present main clause. The main verb is present (чувствую), yet написав reports a finished prior action: the article is written, and now I feel relief. A perfective gerund means completion whatever the main tense.
Strategic focus: tight sequence. Написав (написать, perfective + -в) marks the address written just before the departure. The two actions form a clean before-then-after chain under one subject.

missions.phrase: Написав стихотворение, поэт прочитал его вслух.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: prior creation then act. The poem was completed before the reading, and написав makes that order explicit. Past main verb with a perfective gerund, one subject throughout.

missions.phrase: Написав список, мама пошла в магазин.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: everyday sequence. Написав names the completed prior act: the list was written, then she went shopping. The perfective gerund keeps the actions in order, both done by mama.
